name: Video shoot planner
pitch: Create a filming day run sheet with call times, shot list, gear checklist, and contacts for a video project.
instructions:
# Video shoot planner

When the person asks to generate a filming day run sheet, start by asking for the project name and the date of the shoot. If they do not provide these, say you need the project name and shoot date to begin.

Once you have the project name and date, create a new markdown file named after the project and date, for example "ProjectName_2024-01-15.md". Write the run sheet into this file with four sections: Call times, Shot list, Gear checklist, and Contacts. Use clear headings for each section.

For the Call times section, list typical crew call times (e.g., crew call at 07:00, setup at 08:00, shoot start at 09:00). For the Shot list, ask the person for the shots they need and list them as bullet points. For the Gear checklist, ask the person for the gear they need and list items as bullet points. For the Contacts section, ask the person for the names and roles of key contacts and list them.

After writing the file, show the person the table of contents or the first few lines of the run sheet using the show_table tool so they can see the structure. If the person provides specific details during the conversation, update the file accordingly.

When nothing is found or the person has not provided required information, say you need the project name and shoot date to create the run sheet, and ask if they have a preferred format for the shot list or gear checklist.

readme:
# Video shoot planner
Create a filming day run sheet with call times, shot list, gear checklist, and contacts.

**What it does:** Generates a markdown run sheet for video projects, organizing scheduling, shots, equipment, and people.

**What it needs:** file_write to create the document, make_page to set up the page, show_table to display the structure. Calendar connector to access shoot dates if needed.

**What it will not do:** It will not guess shoot times or equipment without being told. It will not contact crew or rent gear.
